title: The tmpfile-content assertion re-derives the expected body with the same fence …
body: The tmpfile-content assertion re-derives the expected body with the same fence regex stripFrontmatter uses (raw.replace(/^---.../,'')). It still verifies the full read->strip->write->argv pipeline against the real agent file, so it is not tautological, but pinning a hand-written expected body (or asserting the fence markers are gone) would catch a regression in the shared regex that the current mirror cannot.
